messages:
Marie Chen: FYI — Finexus asked for a single-pack response: RBAC mapping export, KMS rotation evidence, and audit log shipping proof for onboarding. They want details for on‑prem HSM + cloud KMS pattern.
Alex Martinez: can you paste the exact questionnaire asks? which retention windows and SIEM format do they want?
Marie Chen: excerpt: "Provide role->resource mapping export, proof of KMS key rotation in last 12 months, and end-to-end audit pipeline (format, retention, redaction policy)." retention = 7 years preferred. SIEM: CEF or JSON.
Jamal Price: quick notes — RBAC export: we can provide a time-stamped CSV + ACL diffs. For ephemeral creds we need to show rotation events (service account rotations + short-lived tokens).
Grace Li: grabbing the runbook draft. My plan: 1) RBAC export cmd 2) KMS rotation proof (audit log slices) 3) SIEM sample message 4) incident timeline template.
Alex Martinez: about KMS proof — customer expects tamper-evidence chain. For hosted we have audit logs in GCS (immutable prefix) and for private we can provide signed manifests. Is the ask strictly tenant-level key rotations or platform-KEK rotations too?
Marie Chen: they call out both tenant key rotations and HSM-backed platform rotations. They want which keys were rotated, who initiated, and proof the old key is no longer used.
Jamal Price: for HSM/on‑prem: we can provide HSM audit export (vendor CSV) + signed hash manifest. For hosted KMS: export CloudAudit logs scoped to key resource. Example query: 
```
resource.type="kms_key" AND protoPayload.methodName:("Encrypt" OR "UpdateCryptoKeyVersion") AND timestamp:>="2025-03-01T00:00:00Z"
```
Grace Li: good. For the RBAC CSV header I propose: role, principal, resource, binding_ts, granted_by, grant_ticket_id. We'll include a small sample with <redacted> PII.
Alex Martinez: about redaction — customer insists on removing user emails from exported artifacts. We should provide a mapping table showing pseudonymization approach and a matching HMAC of original identifiers stored internally.
Marie Chen: agree. Provide pseudonymization + internal HMACs for audit. Note: do NOT ship HMACs to customer. They only want process description and examples.
sec-bot: checklist created: [RBAC export, KMS logs slice, HSM audit extract, SIEM sample, redaction description, IR timeline]. Link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/cust-onboard-5864123456
Oncall Bot: scheduled a sync call with Finexus Tue 09:00 PST. Invite sent to @Alex @Marie @Grace.
Jamal Price: one more technical detail — we should include a short forensic play for key-compromise scenario: what artifacts we can provide (audit chain, key usage metrics, cache lifetimes) and expected time-to-rerotate. Suggest adding a timeline template: detection, containment, rotation, validation, customer notification.
Grace Li: I'll draft the timeline and include sample command outputs. Example export command for hosted audit slice: 
```
redwoodctl audit export --from 2025-03-01 --to 2025-03-31 --filter "protoPayload.methodName:UpdateCryptoKeyVersion" --format jsonl --out finexus_kms_march.jsonl
```
Alex Martinez: for SIEM sample, include one CEF (generic) and one JSON event that shows: timestamp, actor, action, resource, request_id, auth_context. Keep PII redacted.
Marie Chen: action items: Grace -> draft runbook & timeline (EOD Monday). Jamal -> assemble HSM export + signed manifest (EOD Monday). Alex -> prepare SIEM samples + redaction appendix (Wednesday). I'll consolidate and send final package to Finexus before Thu.
Grace Li: ack. I'll include a short note on retention policies (7y archival + 90d hot logs) and automated snapshot schedule.
Jamal Price: also adding a short section on vuln triage and IR: how we map CVE -> affected components -> observed audit entries. Small example snippet included.
Alex Martinez: if Finexus asks for live validation, we can offer a controlled demo where we run a test rotation in a dedicated tenant. Need ops approval.
Marie Chen: noted. I'll loop in Ops after we finish the draft. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
sec-bot: follow-up reminder set for 2025-04-02.
Oncall Bot: call scheduled confirmed. Meeting link sent to attendees.
